# Gabriel Moreno Ribeiro

> Founder & Researcher | Build Year | Co-Founder & CEO of HIBEEX

Website: https://gabrielmr.com

Last updated: July 2026

## Summary

Gabriel Moreno Ribeiro is an 18-year-old Brazilian founder and researcher, currently on a build year. He is Co-Founder & CEO of HIBEEX, a FinTech startup giving small and medium businesses access to financial AI — turning messy financial data into decisions owners can actually act on. HIBEEX is one of 6 startups in the Canastra Ventures AI Residency, and Gabriel is one of the youngest founders the program has ever selected.

He was admitted to the University of St Andrews with a Global Merit Scholarship and approved in 1st place at Insper for Computer Engineering — and chose to take a build year to go deeper on what he's creating before starting university.

What drives him: using technology and science to widen access — to capital, to education, and to opportunity.

## Highlights

- **Co-Founder & CEO of HIBEEX** (January 2026 - present) — financial AI for SMBs. One of 6 startups in the Canastra Ventures AI Residency. Full stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, AWS.
- **Fintech savings RCT** — designed and ran a randomized controlled trial with 208 public-school students on how fintech tools change savings behavior, advised by Aaron Litvin, Ph.D. (Harvard). Treatment group increased savings by 130%.
- **Chemical kinetics research** under Prof. Juliano Bonacin, Ph.D. — reaction mechanisms modeled with 97% accuracy in a 59-page thesis.
- **39 olympiad medals** (19 gold, 2 international) across 49 academic olympiads. 1st of 10,000+ at IFT-UNESP. Gold at ONNEQ (top 0.675%). 1st at OBAQ (top 0.014%).
- **Projeto Candela** — founded a social project building low-cost physics lab kits that reached 3,392 students across 28 public schools, cutting physics failure rates from 30% to 10%.
- **SAT 1510/1600** — top 1% in Brazil.
- **Fundacao Estudar PREP scholar** — one of ~70 from 10,000+ applicants (0.7% acceptance).
- **Instituto Principia** (Escola de Talentos, 14 selected nationally) — advanced physics: quantum mechanics, relativity, statistical physics.
- **Co-Founder & CEO of GSAT Education** (2025-2026) — EdTech for standardized test prep.
- **President of the Olympic Club at Colegio Militar** — 17 initiatives, +47% participation, +62% national olympiad results.
